llms.body:
# Leonardo.Ai

> Leonardo.Ai is where creators make images, video, audio and 3D with AI models. They create in the web app, or through an AI assistant connected to the MCP server. Developers build with the REST API.

## When to use Leonardo.Ai

Reach for Leonardo when someone wants to:

- Create marketing images and video from a prompt: campaign visuals, social posts and banners.
- Keep a character, product or brand style consistent across a set of images, with image references and a fixed seed.
- Create a video from a prompt or an image, or one that moves from a start frame to an end frame.
- Upscale an image: Precise keeps its detail faithful, and Creative reinterprets it at the Creativity Strength you set.
- Remove an image's background for a transparent cutout.
- Design images with accurate, readable text, such as posters.
- Create music, sound effects, spoken dialogue or 3D assets.

## Choose how to call it

- **Web app** at https://app.leonardo.ai: a creator prompts, refines and edits in the browser.
- **MCP server**: a creator works with Leonardo through their AI assistant, in the chat.
- **REST API**: developers build Leonardo into an app, a backend or a batch job.

## MCP server

- **v1, with an API key:** `https://mcp.leonardo.ai/v1/mcp`. Send a Leonardo API key in the `API-Key` header. Create images with Lucid Origin, Lucid Realism and Ideogram 3.0. Setup guide: https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/connect-to-leonardoai-mcp.md
- **v2, with OAuth sign-in:** `https://mcp.leonardo.ai/v2/mcp`, over Streamable HTTP. The creator signs in with OAuth 2.1 and PKCE, so no API key is needed. OAuth metadata: https://mcp.leonardo.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource. An account without v2 access gets HTTP 403; use v1 with an API key instead.
  - Create with any model the API serves: `list_models`, then `get_model_schema`, then `generate`, then `get_generation`.
  - Brief Leonardo Agent for exploration and follow-up edits: `agent_create_project`, `agent_send_message`, then poll `agent_list_messages`.
  - Scopes: `mcp.generate` for generation, `mcp.agent` for Leonardo Agent, `offline_access` for refresh tokens.

## REST API

- Base URL: `https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v2`
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`. Keep the key server-side. Get one with the quick start below.
- `GET /models`: the models the API serves, with their parameters. Reference: https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/getmodels.md
- `POST /generations`: starts a generation and returns its id in `generate.generationId`. One endpoint for every kind of output: images, video, audio, 3D, upscales and background removal. Get the result by webhook callback, which you set on the API key (https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/guide-to-the-webhook-callback-feature.md), or poll `GET https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations/{generationId}` until `generations_by_pk.status` is `COMPLETE` or `FAILED`. Reference: https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/creategeneration.md
- `POST /generationssync`: returns the finished result in the response, for sync-capable models; it times out after about 27 seconds. Reference: https://docs.leonardo.ai/reference/createsyncgeneration.md
- OpenAPI: each reference page above holds the OpenAPI 3.0 definition for its endpoint.
- Official SDKs: Python https://github.com/Leonardo-Interactive/leonardo-python-sdk and TypeScript https://github.com/Leonardo-Interactive/leonardo-ts-sdk

## REST API quick start

1. Sign in at https://app.leonardo.ai, buy API credit on the API Access page (https://app.leonardo.ai/api-access), then create a key at https://app.leonardo.ai/api-access/api-keys. Generations spend API credit, which is separate from the tokens you use in the web app.
2. Check the key by listing the models it can call. A `401` means the key is missing or wrong.

   ```sh
   export LEONARDO_API_KEY="<api_key>"
   curl https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v2/models \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $LEONARDO_API_KEY"
   ```

3. Start an image generation. Lucid Origin needs only a prompt. The response holds `generate.generationId`.

   ```sh
   curl -X POST https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v2/generations \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $LEONARDO_API_KEY" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"model": "lucid-origin", "parameters": {"prompt": "A watercolor lighthouse at dawn", "quantity": 1}}'
   ```

4. Poll the generation until `generations_by_pk.status` is `COMPLETE` or `FAILED`. On `COMPLETE`, the image URLs are in `generations_by_pk.generated_images[].url`.

   ```sh
   curl https://cloud.leonardo.ai/api/rest/v1/generations/<generationId> \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $LEONARDO_API_KEY"
   ```

## Docs

- [Docs index for agents](https://docs.leonardo.ai/llms.txt): every guide, model guide and API reference page, as Markdown.
- [Quick start](https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/getting-started.md): create an API key and make a first generation.
- [API error messages](https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/api-error-messages.md)

## Pricing and models

- [Pricing](https://leonardo.ai/pricing): web app plans, including the free tier, plus team and API plans.
- [API pricing guide](https://docs.leonardo.ai/docs/payg-guide.md): pay-as-you-go API credit in US dollars.
- [API overview](https://leonardo.ai/api)
- [Models](https://leonardo.ai/models): the image and video models in Leonardo.
